notes:
{新聞社|しんぶんしゃ} refers to a company that publishes and distributes newspapers. It covers the entire organization, not just the printing operation.

FORMS:
⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧ (newspaper) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→社：04660_sha⟧ (company). The suffix ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ is commonly used for companies: ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧ (publisher), ⟦{商社|しょうしゃ}→商社：18484_shousha⟧ (trading company).
